contrastAgent._instruction: Add the contrast agent(s) administered for this acquisition, including for each the agent identity and administered amount; if no contrast agent was used, leave this field null. Include all agents given prior to or during the scan.

device._instruction: Add the magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scanner used for this acquisition. This reference should identify the specific device configuration under which the scan was performed.

distortionCorrection._instruction: Add the distortion correction data used for this acquisition, linking to the calibration files applied during image reconstruction or post-processing. If no distortion correction was performed, leave this field null.

input._instruction: Add the state of the subject or tissue sample before this session.

motionCorrection._instruction: Add the calibration file used for motion correction, corresponding to single-band reference image, for this volume.

output._instruction: Add the file generated during this session.

registrationData._instruction: Add the registration file corresponding to structural MRI relevant for this acquisition.

specimenOrientation._instruction: Add the anatomical orientation of the specimen in the scanner.
